title: Wasserstein-Barycentric Interaction Fields for Spatial Factor Models: Evidence from Language-Model Representations
abstract: arXiv:2608.29669v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Spatial return models take the interaction matrix as given and leave feedback uninterpreted. We construct a bandwidth-free field from firms' language-model article embedding distributions using target-anchored Wasserstein barycentric reconstruction. A quadratic exposure-adjustment problem maps feedback into a peer-misalignment penalty ratio. For 52 firms, the field, frozen from 2018-2022 news, yields a 2023-2026 penalty ratio of 3.46 (95% interval [2.89, 4.17]) and higher conditional quasi-likelihood than equal-weighted peer support or RBF weighting of the same distances. Joint penalty ratios for the barycentric and news co-mention fields are 2.33 and 0.86 with boundary calibrated tests which reject both exclusions.

translated_title: 用于空间因子模型的Wasserstein重心交互场：来自语言模型表示的证据
translated_abstract: 空间收益模型通常将交互矩阵视为给定，且未对反馈效应做出解释。我们利用目标锚定的Wasserstein重心重构方法，从公司的语言模型文章嵌入分布中构建了一个无需带宽参数的交互场。通过一个二次型暴露调整问题，将反馈效应映射为同业错位惩罚比率。对于52家公司，该场基于2018-2022年新闻数据冻结，在2023-2026年期间产生了3.46的惩罚比率（95%区间为[2.89, 4.17]），且其条件拟似然高于等权重同业支持或基于相同距离的RBF加权方法。重心场与新闻共同提及场的联合惩罚比率分别为2.33和0.86，边界校准检验拒绝了将两者排除的假设。
tldr: 该论文提出利用目标锚定的Wasserstein重心重构方法，从公司语言模型文章嵌入分布中构建无需带宽参数的空间交互场，将公司间反馈效应量化为同业错位惩罚比率，并在样本外检验中表现出优于等权重和RBF加权方法的预测能力。
en_tdlr: The paper constructs a bandwidth-free spatial interaction field from firms' language-model article embedding distributions via target-anchored Wasserstein barycentric reconstruction, quantifying inter-firm feedback as a peer-misalignment penalty ratio that outperforms equal-weighted and RBF weighting in out-of-sample quasi-likelihood tests.
